blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer’s hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders. In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder’s space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce REPresentation Injection (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over 43.5 × 43.5\times . Code will be available at https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI .
blocks.zh: 近期的表示调和方法通过将变压器隐藏状态的预测与预先训练好的视觉编码器的表示相配合,加速了传播变压器的培训. 在这项工作中,我们探索了REPA的反向和互补方向:我们不是向编码器的空间投射扩散表示,而是在扩散变压器中注入编码表示,让他们积极参与去诺化过程. 为此,我们引入了基于脚手架对内化战略的REPresentation Injection(REPI)培训框架,其中预测的编码器表示最初作为临时脚手架,然后被扩散变压器逐渐内化. REPI在一系列广泛的骨干部门中都优于REPA,并且对它具有高度的互补性:两者的结合,单靠两者就能产生巨大的收益。 值得注意的是,由于只有160K培训步骤,REPI + REPA 与 vanilla SiT 进行了7M培训,速度超过43.5×43.5\时。 守则见https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) exhibit strong scalability for visual generation, but achieving high sample quality still requires extensive training. Representation Alignment (REPA) ( Yu et al., 2025 ) attributes this inefficiency to the difficulty DiTs face in learning semantically structured visual representations, and addresses it by distilling knowledge from a pretrained visual encoder: the diffusion transformer’s hidden states are projected and aligned with the encoder’s representations via an auxiliary objective ( Singh et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) . In this paper, we explore a reverse and complementary direction: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder’s space, can encoder representations instead be projected into the diffusion transformer and actively participate in denoising during training?
blocks.zh: 扩散变形器(DiTs)(Peebles和Xie,2023年;Ma等人,2024年;Esser等人,2024年)在视觉生成上表现出强烈的可伸缩性,但实现高样本质量仍然需要广泛的培训. 表示对等(Yu等人,2025年)将这种低效率归因于DiTs在学习模拟结构视觉表示时面临的困难,并通过从预先训练的视觉编码器中提取知识来解决:扩散变压器的隐藏状态通过辅助目标预测并与编码器的表示一致(Singh等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年c年)。 在本文中,我们探索一个反向和互补的方向:与其将扩散表示投射到编码器的空间中,不如把编码器表示投射到扩散变压器中,并积极参与训练时的去名化?

blocks.en: We begin with a naive design that directly reverses REPA: the encoder output is projected through a lightweight projection layer, and the resulting projection entirely replaces the hidden state at an intermediate layer of the diffusion transformer. However, since this hidden state is the output of a transformer block (see Figure 8 for an illustration), overwriting it discards all prior computation on the noisy input. As a result, subsequent blocks can no longer condition their predictions on the noisy input, causing training to collapse and generated samples to remain pure noise.
blocks.zh: 我们从一个天真的设计开始,它直接反射REPA:编码器输出通过一个轻量级的投影层进行预测,由此产生的投影完全取代了扩散变压器中间层的隐藏状态. 然而,由于这个隐藏状态是变压器块的输出(图8为插图),所以它覆盖了所有先前在噪音输入上的计算. 因此,之后的区块无法再将预测条件限制在噪音输入上,导致训练崩溃,生成样品仍为纯噪音.

blocks.en: This observation motivates moving the injection point inside the transformer block: rather than overwriting the block output, we replace an intermediate quantity within the block, such as the attention output or the key/value (KV) representations. This preserves the flow of information from the noisy input to the block output. For instance, replacing the KV representations still allows the preceding computation to reach subsequent blocks through the query (Q) representations and the residual shortcut. To investigate the potential of this injection strategy, we first consider an idealized oracle setting with access to encoder representations at inference time. Within only 30K training steps, this oracle injection method achieves a lower FID than vanilla SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) trained for 7M steps, indicating that encoder representations can provide a useful signal for denoising.
blocks.zh: 这种观察可以促使注入点在变压器块内移动:我们不是覆盖块输出,而是替换块内的中间数量,如注意输出或键/值(KV)表示. 这保存了从噪音输入到块输出的信息流. 例如,替换 KV 表达式仍然允许先前的计算通过查询(Q)表达式和剩余快捷键到达后续块. 为了调查这种注射策略的潜力,我们首先考虑一种理想化的甲骨文设置,在推论时可以访问编码器的表示. 仅在30K训练步骤内,这种甲骨文注射法的FID比为7M步骤训练的vanilla SiT(Ma等人,2024年)要低,表明编码器的表示可以提供一个有用的去诺信号.

blocks.en: However, this oracle setting relies on encoder representations extracted from clean images at inference time, which are unavailable in standard generation. To close this gap, we introduce REPresentation Injection (REPI), which adopts a scaffold-to-internalization training strategy that eliminates the need for encoder representations at inference time. REPI treats the injected encoder representations as a scaffold: during early training, the internal representations at one layer of the diffusion transformer are replaced by projections of the encoder representations; the scaffold is then removed, and the diffusion transformer resumes computing its own representations at that layer. To facilitate this internalization, we introduce an internalization objective that encourages the self-computed representations to match the injected encoder representations. This process allows the model to first learn to exploit the semantically structured representations provided by the scaffold, and then to learn to reproduce compatible representations on its own. After training, the visual encoder is discarded, and the resulting model is architecturally identical to the original diffusion transformer at inference.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种甲骨文设置依赖于在推论时间从干净图像中提取的编码器表示,在标准生成中是没有的. 为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了无编码注射法(REPI),它采用脚手架对内部化培训战略,消除了推断时对编码表述的需求. REPI将注射的编码器表示器作为脚手架处理:在早期训练中,扩散变压器的一层内部表示器被预测的编码器表示器所取代;然后将脚手架去除,扩散变压器恢复在该层计算自己的表示器. 为了促进这种内化,我们引入了一个内化目标,鼓励自我计算的表达方式与注入编码器的表达方式相匹配. 这个过程使模型首先学习利用脚手架提供的有条理的表示,然后学习自己复制兼容的表示. 训练后,视觉编码器被丢弃,由此产生的模型在建筑上与推论时的原始扩散变压器完全相同.

blocks.en: Complementarity with REPA. REPI is highly complementary to REPA, as the two methods leverage encoder representations through different mechanisms: REPA encourages the diffusion transformer to learn the structure of encoder representations through an auxiliary alignment loss, while REPI injects and internalizes these representations into the denoising computation, adapting their structure to the denoising task. Empirically, on SiT-XL ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , REPI alone achieves an FID of 14.51 at 100K training steps, compared with 19.40 for REPA, and combining both methods further reduces FID to 11.78, substantially outperforming either method alone.
blocks.zh: REPI是对REPA的高度补充,因为这两种方法通过不同机制利用编码器的表示: REPA鼓励扩散变压器通过辅助对齐损失来学习编码器表示的结构,而REPI将这些表示注入并内化到去诺化计算中,使其结构适应去诺化的任务. 经验是,在SiT-XL(Ma等人,2024年)上,REPI单在100K培训步骤上就达到14.51的FID,而REPA为19.40,结合这两种方法,FID进一步减少到11.78, 单是两种方法都大大超过两种方法。

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments on class-conditional ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) generation across multiple model scales to demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Our approach achieves superior generation quality and training efficiency compared with several state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, on SiT-XL, REPI combined with REPA achieves an FID of 8.22 within only 160K training steps, matching the FID of 8.30 obtained by vanilla SiT after 7M steps, a training speedup of over 43.5 × 43.5\times . Furthermore, our method at 200K steps already outperforms REPA trained for 400K steps.
blocks.zh: 我们在多个模型尺度上对类条件成像网(Deng等人,2009年)进行广泛的实验,以展示我们的方法的有效性。 我们的做法与若干最新基线相比,提高了发电质量和培训效率。 值得注意的是,在SiT-XL上,REPI与REPA结合,只在160K培训步骤内实现了8.22的FID,与香草SIT在7M步骤后获得的8.30的FID相匹配,培训速度超过43.5×43.5\时。 此外,我们200K级的教学方法已经超过了《卢旺达环境保护法》培训的400K级。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We explore a direction that is reverse and complementary to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder’s space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. • We introduce REPI, a training framework that internalizes semantically structured representations from pretrained visual encoders into the diffusion transformer via a scaffold-to-internalization strategy. • We show that REPI alone outperforms REPA, while the two remain highly complementary. Combined with REPA, our model trained for only 160K steps surpasses vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over 43.5 × 43.5\times .
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们探索一个反向和补充REPA的方向:我们不是将扩散表示投射到编码器的空间,而是在扩散变压器中注入编码表示器,使他们能够积极参与去诺化过程. —— 我们采用REPI,通过脚手架对内化战略,将经过预先训练的视觉编码器结构化的表示器内化为扩散变压器。 我们显示,单是可再生能源方案就比《环境保护法》要好,而两者仍然高度互补。 与REPA一起,我们仅培训了160K步的模型超过了培训了7M步的香草SiT,速度超过43.5×43.5乘。

blocks.en: We explore a direction that is reverse and complementary to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder’s space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process.

blocks.en: 3 Can Encoder Representations Participate in Denoising?
blocks.zh: 3 编码代表能够参与德诺瓦辛?.

blocks.en: REPA transfers knowledge from a pretrained visual encoder to a diffusion transformer through a regularization term that aligns the transformer’s projected hidden states with target representations from the encoder. In this section, we investigate a complementary question: rather than aligning with encoder representations, can they instead be mapped directly into the diffusion transformer and participate actively in denoising? We first examine this question under a diagnostic oracle setting, in which encoder representations are assumed to be available at inference time. Section 4 then introduces our method, which eliminates the need for encoder representations at inference time.
blocks.zh: REPA通过一个规范化的术语,将知识从预先训练的视觉编码器转移到扩散变压器上,该术语将变压器的预测隐藏状态与编码器的目标表示相配合. 在本节中,我们调查了一个补充问题:与其与编码器的表示一致,不如直接将其映射到扩散变压器中,并积极参与去名化? 我们首先在诊断性甲骨文中审查这个问题,其中假定在推断时可以得到编码器的表示。 然后,第4节介绍了我们的方法,它消除了在推断时间提出编码符的必要性。

blocks.en: A naive design is to simply reverse the mapping direction of REPA: instead of projecting diffusion hidden states into the encoder’s space, we use a lightweight projection layer to map encoder representations into the diffusion hidden-state space and substitute them for an intermediate hidden state. This design fails catastrophically, yielding an FID of 212.5 (Table 1 ). We attribute this failure to the fact that the hidden state is the output of a transformer block (Figure 8 ), so replacing it entirely severs all subsequent blocks from the noisy input. This failure suggests that external representations must be injected without overwriting the input-dependent stream. We therefore instead inject representations inside the attention module, testing five alternatives that all preserve the flow of information from the noisy input to the block output (Table 1 ). Details of these variants are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 一个天真的设计就是简单地扭转REPA的映射方向:我们不是将扩散隐藏状态投射到编码器的空间中,而是使用轻量级投影层将编码器的表示映射到扩散隐藏状态空间中,代之以中间隐藏状态. 这种设计灾难性失败,产生212.5的FID(表1)。 我们将此失败归因于隐藏状态是变压器块的输出(图8),因此替换它会将所有后续的块与噪音输入完全断开. 这一失败表明,外部表示必须注入,而不必覆盖依赖输入的流。 因此,我们在关注模块中输入表示,测试五个选择,所有选择都保留信息从噪音输入到块输出的流程(表1)。 这些变体的详细情况见附录B。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , all five variants achieve strong oracle FID after only 30K training steps, with V-only injection performing best. A plausible explanation is that V-only injection preserves the diffusion transformer’s native attention routing through Q and K, while injecting semantic content from the encoder via V. Note that the optimal injection location differs for our full model, as discussed in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,所有五个变体在仅经过30K训练步骤后都实现了强甲骨文FID,只有V型注射效果最好. 一个合理的解释是,只有V型的注射能保留扩散变压器通过Q和K的原生注意力,同时通过V型的编码器注入语义内容. 如第4.2节所述,我们整个型号的最佳注射位置不同。

blocks.en: Although this oracle setting is impractical, as it assumes access to encoder representations at inference time, these results indicate that projected encoder representations can substantially benefit the denoising process. We next describe how our method eliminates this dependence on encoder representations.
blocks.zh: 虽然这种甲骨文设置是不切实际的,因为它假定在推论时间可以获得编码器表示,但这些结果表明,预测的编码器表示可以大大有利于解密过程. 我们接下来描述我们的方法如何消除对编码器表述的依赖。

blocks.zh: 4 RePI: 代表注射和内化

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: The oracle setting in Section 3 requires representations extracted from clean images during sampling, which are unavailable in standard generation. To eliminate this dependency, we propose REPresentation Injection (REPI), which treats projected encoder representations as a scaffold and internalizes their benefit into the diffusion transformer. As illustrated in Figure 2 , REPI projects a representation extracted from a clean image and substitutes it for the native representation within the diffusion transformer (Section 4.2 ). After a small number of training steps, we remove the scaffold and restore the native computation, while an internalization objective encourages the native representation to reproduce the representation previously supplied by the scaffold (Section 4.3 ). At inference time, the visual encoder and projection layers are discarded, and sampling relies solely on the original diffusion backbone.
blocks.zh: 第3节中的甲骨文设置要求采样时从干净图像中提取的表示,在标准生成中是没有的. 为了消除这种依赖性,我们提议采用REPRENTENTI注射法(REPI),将预测的编码器表示作为脚手架,并将其好处内化为扩散变压器. 如图2所示,REPI预测从清洁图像中提取的代表物,并代之以在扩散变压器中的本地代表物(第4.2节)。 经过少量的训练步骤后,我们移除脚手架并恢复本土计算,而内化目标则鼓励本土代表复制脚手架之前提供的代表(第4.3节). 在推断时间,视觉编码器和投影层被丢弃,采样完全依赖于原始的传播骨干.

blocks.en: 4.2 Representation Injection
blocks.zh: 4.2 代表注射

blocks.en: REPI initially substitutes projections of clean-image encoder representations for the native representations at a selected diffusion layer, serving as a temporary scaffold that is later removed as training progresses. Specifically, we inject K/V representations, as we empirically find this choice achieves the best results (Table 5 ). This finding is inconsistent with the oracle results in Section 3 , where V-only injection performs best. One possible explanation is that the oracle setting only needs to consider how effectively an external representation can be consumed, whereas REPI additionally requires that the injected representation be subsequently internalized and removed.
blocks.zh: REPI最初取代了在选定的传播层对本地代表的清洁图像编码表示的预测,作为临时脚手架,后来随着培训的进展而被移除. 具体地说,我们输入了K/V表述,因为我们从经验中发现,这一选择取得了最佳结果(表5)。 这一结论与第3节的甲骨文结果不一致,该节中只有V型注射效果最好。 一种可能的解释是,甲骨文设定仅需要考虑外部代表能够在多大程度上有效使用,而REPI还要求注入的代表随后内部化和去除。

blocks.en: Formally, let f f denote a pretrained visual encoder and 𝐱 ∗ {\mathbf{x}}_{*} a clean image. During the forward pass of f ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∗ ) f({\mathbf{x}}_{*}) , we extract the key and value representations ( K ∗ , V ∗ ) (K_{*},V_{*}) computed within its final self-attention layer. At a selected self-attention layer of the diffusion transformer, we introduce two trainable projection layers, h ϕ K h_{\phi_{K}} and h ϕ V h_{\phi_{V}} , which map K ∗ K_{*} and V ∗ V_{*} into the corresponding key and value spaces of that layer: K ¯ = h ϕ K ​ ( K ∗ ) , V ¯ = h ϕ V ​ ( V ∗ ) . \bar{K}=h_{\phi_{K}}(K_{*}),\qquad\bar{V}=h_{\phi_{V}}(V_{*}). (3) We then replace the native key and value representations with K ¯ \bar{K} and V ¯ \bar{V} , respectively. The resulting attention output is Z inj = softmax ⁡ ( Q ​ K ¯ ⊤ d ) ​ V ¯ , Z_{\mathrm{inj}}=\operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{Q\bar{K}^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}}\right)\bar{V}, (4) where Q Q denotes the native query representation and d d is the query/key dimension. For clarity, we omit layer and attention-head indices. REPI changes only the source of the keys and values, leaving the other operations of the attention block unchanged. Notably, in addition to softmax attention, this substitution generalizes to the gated linear attention used in DiG ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) , as demonstrated in Figure 5 .

blocks.en: This design allows information from the noisy input to continue propagating through the native query Q Q and the residual shortcut, preserving the input-dependent information accumulated by preceding blocks. Meanwhile, the projections K ¯ \bar{K} and V ¯ \bar{V} provide a semantically structured key-value memory derived from the clean-image representation, in which the keys determine which external information is retrieved, while the values determine its content.
blocks.zh: 这种设计允许来自噪音输入的信息通过原生查询QQ和剩余快捷键继续传播,保留了之前块积累的依赖输入的信息. 同时,预测 K'\bar{K} 和 V'\ bar{V} 提供了从清真图像表示式中衍生出来的精密结构化的密钥- 值内存, 其中密钥决定了哪些外部信息被检索, 而值则决定其内容.

blocks.en: In practice, we implement h ϕ K h_{\phi_{K}} and h ϕ V h_{\phi_{V}} as linear layers, and select the same diffusion transformer layer and encoder layer as REPA. During training, the diffusion transformer and the projection layers are jointly optimized using the diffusion objective (Eq. 1 ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Internalization and Scaffold Removal
blocks.zh: 4.3 内部化和脚手架清除

blocks.en: The injected encoder representations provide semantically organized content for denoising, but cannot be retained during standard sampling, as their construction requires a clean image. We therefore treat these injected representations not as permanent conditioning, but as a temporary representation scaffold, which we later remove while internalizing its benefit into the diffusion transformer’s native representations.
blocks.zh: 注入的编码器表示器为解诺提供了有组织化的内容,但在标准取样时无法保留,因为其构造需要清洁的图像. 因此,我们将这些注入的表示不是作为永久条件,而是作为临时的表示脚手架,我们后来在将其好处内部化为扩散变压器的本土表示时,将其删除。

blocks.en: A simple strategy is to abruptly remove the scaffold and restore the diffusion transformer’s native representations after a small number of training steps. Surprisingly, even this naive switch improves FID from 39.4 for vanilla SiT to 22.45 at 100K steps. We hypothesize that the scaffold provides a favorable initialization for the other transformer layers: while the scaffold is active, these layers learn to exploit semantically structured encoder representations for denoising. After the scaffold is removed, this learned capability may facilitate subsequent training as the model adapts to its own native representations.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,在经过少量培训之后,突然拆除脚手架并恢复扩散变压器的本土代表。 令人惊讶的是,即使是这个天真的开关,FID也从香草SIT的39.4提高到了100K步的22.45. 我们假设脚手架为其他变压器层提供了有利的初始化:虽然脚手架是活跃的,但这些层学习利用结构化的编码器表示来去诺化. 在脚手架被移除后,随着模型适应自身本土表现,这种学习能力可能有利于后续培训.

blocks.en: To internalize the encoder representations more thoroughly, we introduce an internalization loss that explicitly encourages the native K/V representations to reproduce their encoder-derived counterparts. Specifically, the native representations ( K , V ) (K,V) are trained to match the projections ( K ¯ , V ¯ ) (\bar{K},\bar{V}) : ℒ int = 1 | K | ​ ‖ K − sg ⁡ [ K ¯ ] ‖ F 2 + 1 | V | ​ ‖ V − sg ⁡ [ V ¯ ] ‖ F 2 , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{int}}=\frac{1}{|K|}\left\|K-\operatorname{sg}\!\left[\bar{K}\right]\right\|_{F}^{2}+\frac{1}{|V|}\left\|V-\operatorname{sg}\!\left[\bar{V}\right]\right\|_{F}^{2}, (5) where sg ⁡ [ ⋅ ] \operatorname{sg}[\cdot] denotes the stop-gradient operator and | ⋅ | |\cdot| denotes the number of elements in the corresponding representation.

This internalization loss also facilitates a smooth transition, as it encourages the native K/V representations to remain consistent with their pre-transition states. We additionally experimented with a linearly scheduled transition but observed no further gain, since the internalization loss alone already renders the switch sufficiently smooth.
blocks.zh: 这种内部化损失也有利于平稳过渡,因为它鼓励当地K/V代表与其过渡前状态保持一致。 此外,我们还试验了线性计划过渡,但没有发现进一步的收益,因为仅内部化损失就已使开关足够平滑。

blocks.en: 4.4 Combining REPI with REPA
blocks.zh: 4.4 将REPI与REPA合并

blocks.en: We empirically find that REPI and REPA are highly complementary (Figure 1 ), as the two methods leverage encoder representations through fundamentally different mechanisms. REPA aligns projections of intermediate diffusion representations with corresponding encoder representations, providing diffusion-to-encoder alignment supervision. In contrast, REPI injects and internalizes projections of encoder representations into the denoising computation, forming an encoder-to-diffusion injection mechanism.
blocks.zh: 根据经验,我们发现REPI和REPA是高度互补的(图1),因为这两种方法通过根本不同的机制利用编码器的表示。 REPA将中间扩散表示的预测与相应的编码表示相协调,提供扩散到编码的对接监督. 相比之下,REPI在去诺化计算中注入和内化了编码器表示的预测,形成了编码器对扩散的注射机制.

blocks.en: When combining the two methods, REPA supervision is applied throughout the entire training process, from scaffold to internalization. We place the REPI injection layer before the REPA alignment layer, an ordering that offers two benefits. First, it allows the two mechanisms to operate cooperatively rather than interfere with each other: injecting after the alignment layer would instead alter the subsequent computation, weakening the influence of the REPA supervision applied earlier. Second, once the scaffold is removed, REPA continues to provide semantic supervision at the alignment layer, complementing the internalization objective. Table 8 reports results for different injection-layer choices, showing that reversing the order still improves performance, but the gains are substantially smaller.
blocks.zh: 在结合这两种方法时,从脚手架到内在化的整个培训过程都适用REPA的监督. 我们把REPI注射层放在REPA调整层之前,这个订单提供了两个好处. 首先,它允许两种机制合作运作,而不是相互干涉:调整层之后的注射会改变随后的计算,削弱早先适用的《环境保护法》监督的影响。 第二,脚手架被移除后,REPA继续提供对齐层的语义监督,补充内化目标. 表8报告不同注射层的选择结果,显示改变顺序仍然能改善业绩,但收益却小得多。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Implementation details. We strictly follow the training protocols of REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . To ensure a fair comparison, we fix the training batch size to 256 and adopt the same learning rate and EMA configurations as REPA. For SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) models, we employ the SDE Euler–Maruyama sampler with 250 function evaluations (NFE). When combined with REPA, we always use its default alignment depth and loss weight. Additional implementation details and hyperparameter settings are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 我们严格遵守REPA的训练规程(Yu等人,2025年)。 为了确保进行公平的比较,我们把培训批量规模定在256个,并采用与REPA相同的学习率和EMA配置. 对于SiT(Ma等人,2024年)模型,我们使用SDE Euler–Maruyama取样器,进行250个函数评价(NFE). 当与REPA结合时,我们总是使用它的默认对齐深度和减重. 附录A提供了其他实施细节和超参数设置。

blocks.en: Models and datasets. We evaluate our method on DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , SiT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , and DiG ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) across multiple model scales. Following REPA, our main experiments are conducted on class-conditional ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. We further evaluate on ImageNet at 512 × 512 512\times 512 to assess higher-resolution generation, and on MS-COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) with MM-DiT ( Esser et al., 2024 ) for text-to-image generation. Unless otherwise specified, we adopt DINOv2-B/14 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) as the pretrained visual encoder, and all models operate in the latent space of a pretrained VAE ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) .
blocks.zh: 模型与数据集. 我们通过DiT(Peebles and Xie, 2023年),SiT(Ma等人, 2024年)和DiG(Zhu等人, 2024年)等多个模型尺度来评价我们的方法. 继REPA之后,我们的主要实验是在阶级条件下的ImageNet(Deng等人,2009年)以256×256256\time256分辨率进行. 我们进一步在ImageNet512×512 512\times 512上评价高分辨率生成,在MS-COCO(Lin等人,2014年)和MM-DIT(Esser等人,2024年)上评价文本到图像生成. 除非另有说明,否则我们采用DINOv2-B/14(Oquab等人,2024年)作为预先训练的视觉编码器,所有模型都运行在预先训练的VAE(Kingma and Welling,2013年)的潜在空间中.

blocks.en: Evaluation. We compare our method against four representation alignment methods: REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , iREPA ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , sREPA ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and Stable Velocity ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . We report FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , sFID ( Nash et al., 2021 ) , IS ( Salimans et al., 2016 ) , and Precision/Recall ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2019 ) , all computed on 50K generated samples following the ADM protocol ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) . Unless otherwise noted, all results are obtained using the EMA model without classifier-free guidance (CFG) ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) . For our method, reported training steps account for the entire training process, from scaffold to internalization.
blocks.zh: 评价。 我们比较了我们的方法与四种表示一致的方法:REPA(Yu等人,2025年),iREPA(Singh等人,2026年),SREPA(徐等人,2026年)和Stable Velocity(Yang等人,2026年). 我们报告FID(Heusel等人,2017年),SFID(Nash等人,2021年),IS(Salimans等人,2016年),以及Precent/Recall(Kynkäänniemi等人,2019年),均根据ADM协议(Dhariwal和Nichol,2021年)产生的50K个样本进行计算. 除非另有说明,所有结果均采用EMA模型获得,不采用无分类指导(CFG)(Ho and Salimans, 2022 ). 就我们的方法而言,所报告的培训步骤包括从脚手架到内部化的整个培训过程。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Quantitative results. Table 3 , together with Figures 1 and 5 , presents the quantitative comparison without classifier-free guidance. Across a diverse set of backbones, REPI consistently outperforms REPA, and combining the two methods yields further gains. Notably, on SiT-XL, REPA + REPI achieves an FID of 8.22 after only 160K training steps, matching the FID of 8.30 obtained by vanilla SiT after 7M steps, a training speedup of over 43.5 × 43.5\times . Moreover, REPA + REPI at 200K steps already surpasses REPA at 400K steps. We further evaluate under classifier-free guidance, both with and without the guidance interval ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2024 ) . As shown in Table 3 , REPI alone achieves comparable performance to the baselines, while REPA + REPI achieves the best FID and IS among all methods in both settings.

As shown in Table 4 , REPI consistently outperforms REPA both with and without CFG, reducing FID from 10.40 to 9.47 (w/o CFG) and 4.73 to 4.61 (w/ CFG). Combining REPI with REPA further reduces FID to 9.08 and 4.56, respectively.

blocks.en: 5.3 Generality of REPI
blocks.zh: 5.3 可再生能源方案的一般情况

blocks.en: In this section, we demonstrate that REPI improves diffusion transformer training across a broad range of settings, including visual encoders, diffusion backbones, and injection depths.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们表明REPI改进了包括视觉编码器、传播主干线和注射深度在内的各种环境的传播变压器培训。

blocks.en: Visual encoders. We first study the effect of different visual encoder types and sizes. As shown in Figure 4 , REPI consistently improves upon the vanilla model and outperforms REPA across all encoders. Notably, on several encoders (e.g., MAE and MoCoV3), REPA yields FID scores even worse than vanilla SiT, consistent with observations in iREPA ( Singh et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, REPI still achieves substantial gains on these encoders. For the remaining encoders, combining REPI with REPA further reduces FID substantially.
blocks.zh: 视觉编码器。 我们首先研究不同视觉编码器类型和大小的影响. 如图4所示,REPI在香草模型上不断改进,在所有编码器上都超过了REPA。 值得注意的是,在几个编码器(如MAE和MOCoV3)上,REPA的FID分数比vanilla SiT更差,这与iREPA(Singh等人,2026年)中的意见一致。 相比之下,REPI仍然在这些编码器上取得了巨大的收益. 对于其余的编码器,将REPI与REPA合并进一步大大减少了FID.

REPI consistently outperforms REPA across all ten encoders. Notably, on encoders such as MAE-L and MoCoV3-L, where REPA underperforms vanilla SiT, REPI still achieves substantial gains.

blocks.en: Diffusion backbones. We next evaluate REPI across a diverse set of diffusion transformer backbones. Figure 1 reports results across model scales (SiT-B, SiT-L, and SiT-XL), while Figure 5 examines generality across architectures (DiT-L and DiG-L, spanning standard softmax attention and gated linear attention) and at a higher resolution (SiT-XL at 512 × 512 512\times 512 ). REPI generalizes consistently across model scales, architectures, and resolutions, outperforming REPA in every setting, and combining the two methods yields further substantial gains.
blocks.zh: 传播骨干. 接下来我们通过一系列不同的扩散变压器骨干 来评估再分配指数 图1报告跨模型尺度的结果(SiT-B、SiT-L和SiT-XL),图5则审查跨结构的通用性(DiT-L和DiG-L,跨越标准软马克思的注意力和门的线性注意力)和更高的分辨率(SiT-XL at 512×512 512\times 512). REPI在各种模式、架构和决议中都得到一致的概括,在每一种情况下都优于REPA,将这两种方法结合起来,将产生更大的收益。

blocks.en: Injection depth. Finally, we demonstrate the robustness of REPI to the choice of injection layer. As shown in Figure 5 (d), FID ranges only from 14.51 to 16.97 across injection layers 4 through 14, substantially below the 39.41 achieved by vanilla SiT-XL. Injecting at layer 8 achieves the best performance, consistent with the layer choice adopted in REPA.
blocks.zh: 注入深处. 最后,我们表明REPI在选择注射层方面是强有力的。 如图5(d)所示,FID从14.51到16.97之间只有4至14层,大大低于香草SiT-XL实现的39.41。 第8层的注射可以实现最佳的性能,这与REPA采用的分层选择一致.

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: Scaffold and internalization. Figure 5.4 ablates the contributions of the scaffold and internalization objective by progressively adding each component. The scaffold substantially improves performance over the base model, regardless of whether REPA is applied. Notably, using the scaffold alone, without REPA or the internalization objective (i.e., abrupt scaffold removal), reduces FID on SiT-XL from 17.2 to 9.49 at 400K steps. This suggests that the scaffold provides a favorable initialization for the diffusion transformer, with lasting benefits even after its removal. Applying the internalization objective further reduces FID, both with and without REPA.
blocks.zh: 脚手架与内化. 图5.4通过逐步增加每个组成部分来减少脚手架和内部化目标的贡献。 脚手架比基准模型大大提高了性能,无论REPA是否适用. 值得注意的是,单使用脚手架,不使用REPA或内部化目标(即突然清除脚手架),将SiT-XL的FID从17.2降至400K步的9.49。 这表明脚手架为扩散变压器提供了有利的初始化,即使在拆除后也具有持久的好处. 实行内部化目标进一步减少了食品添加量,无论有无《加拿大环境保护法》。

blocks.en: Table 5: Injection-target ablation (SiT-XL/2, 100K steps).
blocks.zh: 表5:注射-目标膨胀(SiT-XL/2,100K步).

blocks.en: Injection target. We next study where encoder representations should be injected within the attention module, comparing five variants summarized in Table 5 . All variants improve upon vanilla SiT, with K/V injection achieving the best FID and IS. Interestingly, this result contrasts with the oracle study in Section 3 , where V-only injection performs best. We hypothesize that jointly injecting keys and values is better suited to scaffold removal and internalization: the projected keys determine how the native queries retrieve encoder-derived information, while the projected values supply the corresponding content. Notably, injecting into the attention output or into all of Q/K/V yields relatively worse results, suggesting that preserving native queries computed from the noisy input is important for internalization.
blocks.zh: 注射目标。 我们接下来的研究是,在注意单元中注入编码器表示,比较表5概述的五个变体。 所有变体在香草西T上都有改进,K/V注射达到了最好的FID和IS. 有趣的是,这一结果与第3节中的甲骨文研究形成对比,该节中只有V型注射效果最好. 我们假设联合注入键和值更适合脚手架清除和内化:预测键决定了原生查询如何检索编码器生成的信息,而预测值提供相应的内容. 值得注意的是,向注意力输出或向所有Q/K/V输入的结果相对较差,这表明保留从噪音输入中计算的本地查询对于内部化很重要。

blocks.en: Scaffold duration. We also investigate the effect of scaffold duration, varying it from 10K to 30K training steps. As shown in Figure 7 (a), performance remains stable across durations, with FID varying by only 0.22, demonstrating that our method is robust to this choice. Notably, a short scaffold duration is sufficient to achieve strong performance in practice, as our oracle experiments show that the projection layers can be learned effectively within a small number of training steps.
blocks.zh: 脚手架持续时间. 我们还调查脚手架持续时间的影响,从10K到30K的训练步骤不等. 如图7(a)所示,不同时期的业绩保持稳定,FID只差0.22,表明我们的方法对这一选择是强有力的。 值得注意的是,短的脚手架持续时间足以在实践中实现强效,因为我们的甲骨文实验表明,在少数培训步骤中可以有效地学习投影层.

blocks.zh: 图6:脚手架与内化目标的差距. 从SiT-XL/2开始,(a)没有REPA,(b)没有REPA,我们逐渐增加了脚手架和内化目标. 每一组成部分都不断改进FID。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Robustness to scaffold duration and internalization loss weight. REPI achieves stable FID across (a) scaffold durations and (b) internalization loss weights, evaluated on SiT-XL/2 at 400K training steps.
blocks.zh: 图7:脚手架持续时间的强度和内化减重. REPI在(a)脚手架持续时间和(b)内部化损失权重之间实现稳定的FID,在SiT-XL/2上在400K培训步骤上评价.

blocks.en: Internalization loss weight. Figure 7 (b) shows that REPI is also robust to the internalization loss weight. Varying λ \lambda from 1.0 to 4.0 yields similar FID scores, ranging between 7.21 and 7.28. We use λ = 2 \lambda=2 by default, which achieves the best result among the tested values.
blocks.zh: 内化减重. 图7(b)显示REPI对内化减重也很强。 Vorying QQ\lambda从1.0到4.0得出类似的FID分数,从7.21到7.28不等. 我们默认使用 QQ = 2\lambda = 2,这在测试值中实现了最佳效果.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion transformer. Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) adopt Vision Transformers ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) as backbones for latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , while Scalable Interpolant Transformers (SiTs) ( Ma et al., 2024 ) connect diffusion and flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) through stochastic interpolants. Subsequent works improve efficiency through linear attention ( Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Choromanski et al., 2021 ) and masked image modeling ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2022 ) , and training strategies that accelerate convergence without architectural modifications ( Yao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 散变器. 扩散变形器(DiTs)(Peebles and Xie, 2023年)采用Vision变形器(Dosovitskiy等人, 2021年)作为潜在扩散的骨干(Rombach等人, 2022年),而可伸缩的国际刑警组织变形器(SiTs)(Ma等人, 2024年)通过线粒体插件连接扩散和流配(Lipman等人, 2023年). 随后的作品通过线性关注(谢等人,2025年;朱等人,2024年;王等人,2025年b;卡特哈罗普洛斯等人,2020年;王等人,2020年;乔罗曼斯基等人,2021年)和蒙面形象模型制作(郑等人,2024年;高高等人,2023年;贺等人,2022年),以及不经建筑改造而加速趋同的培训策略(姚等人,2024年),提高了效率.

blocks.en: Representation alignment for generation. REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) accelerates diffusion transformer training by aligning intermediate features with clean-image representations from pretrained visual encoders. Subsequent work refines the alignment target and training strategy by emphasizing spatial structure ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , aligning relational geometry ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , terminating alignment early in training ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , or adopting more flexible and adaptive alignment schemes ( Pang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Mo and Yun, 2026 ) . Other work derives alignment targets from the diffusion process itself ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ) or from VAE features ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Min et al., 2026 ) , while others optimize the generative latent space directly or jointly model image and semantic representations ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Leng et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) . The paradigm has further been extended to U-Nets ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , pixel-space transformers ( Shin et al., 2026 ) , and video generation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Lian et al., 2026 ) . Unlike these methods, which treat external representations as an alignment target, we assign them a complementary role: projected encoder representations are temporarily injected into the denoising computation as a scaffold, while the model’s native representations gradually internalize this guidance.
blocks.zh: 世代代表制调整. REPA(Yu et al.,2025)通过将中间特性与预先训练的视觉编码器的清真图像表示一致,加速了扩散变压器培训. 随后的工作通过强调空间结构(Singh等人,2026年),调整关系几何(徐等人,2026年),在培训初期终止调整(Wang等人,2025年c),或采用更加灵活和适应性的调整办法(Pang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a;Mo和Yun,2026年),完善了调整目标和培训战略。 其他工作来自传播过程本身(Jiang等人,2025年;Peng等人,2026年;Chefer等人,2026年)或VAE特征(Wang等人,2026年;Min等人,2026年),而其他工作则直接或联合优化基因潜在空间模型图像和语义表达(Yao等人,2025年;Leng等人,2025年;Kouzelis等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年a年)。 范式进一步扩展到U-Nets(Tian等人,2025年),像素空间变压器. (Shin等人,2026年),和视频生成(张等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年b;Lian等人,2026年). 与这些方法不同的是,这些方法将外部表达视为一个对齐目标,我们赋予它们一个互补的作用:预测的编码器表达作为脚手架暂时注入去名计算,而模型的本土表达则逐渐将这一指导内化.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced REPI, a training framework that leverages pretrained vision encoders in a direction complementary to REPA. Specifically, we investigated whether encoder representations can be injected into a diffusion transformer to benefit the denoising task. REPI follows a scaffold-to-internalization strategy: projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold, while an internalization objective encourages the diffusion transformer to reproduce compatible representations on its own. Extensive experiments show that REPI improves both the generation quality and training efficiency of diffusion transformers. We hope this work will motivate further exploration of how external representations can be leveraged in generative training. Promising future directions include extending REPI beyond image generation to video generation and other generative domains.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了REPI,这是一个培训框架,利用预先培训的视觉编码器,朝补充REPA的方向发展。 具体地说,我们调查了是否可将编码器的表示注入扩散变压器,以利去名任务. REPI遵循脚手架对内化策略:预测编码器表示方式最初作为临时脚手架,而内部化目标则鼓励扩散变压器自行复制兼容的表示方式. 广泛的实验表明,REPI提高了扩散变压器的生成质量和培训效率. 我们希望这项工作将推动进一步探索如何利用外部陈述进行基因培训。 有希望的未来方向包括将REPI从图像生成扩展到视频生成和其他基因域.

Training is conducted in fp16 mixed precision with torch.compile for improved throughput, together with gradient clipping and an exponential moving average (EMA) of the generative model weights for stable optimization. For DiT-L/2 and DiG-L/2, we adopt the Improved DDPM objective of Nichol and Dhariwal (2021) , predicting both noise and variance. Hyperparameters for different backbones when using REPI alone (i.e., without REPA) are summarized in Table 6 .

blocks.en: As described in Section 3 , the oracle experiment is a diagnostic evaluation that assumes access to clean-image encoder representations at inference time. We investigate six injection targets: (1) hidden state, (2) attention output, (3) Q/K/V, (4) K/V, (5) K only, and (6) V only. The corresponding injection interfaces within a transformer block are illustrated in Figure 8 . All six variants inject at block 8 of SiT-XL/2.
blocks.zh: 如第3节所述,甲骨文实验是一种诊断性评价,假定在推论时间可获得清洁图像编码器的表示. 我们调查6个注射目标:(1)隐藏状态,(2)注意力输出,(3)Q/K/V,(4)K/V,(5)只K,(6)只V. 图8显示了变压器块内的相应注入接口。 在SiT-XL/2第8区注入的所有6种变体.

blocks.en: Hidden state. The injection source is the encoder output, and the target is the hidden state of a transformer block (i.e., the block’s output). As shown in Table 1 , this setting fails catastrophically, yielding an FID of 212.5, because overwriting the block’s output discards the noisy-input-dependent state accumulated by all preceding blocks.
blocks.zh: 隐藏状态。 注入源是编码器输出,目标为变压器块的隐藏状态(即块输出). 如表1所示,这种设置是灾难性的,产生了212.5的FID,因为覆盖区块的输出会丢弃以前所有区块累积起来的依赖投入的噪音状态。

blocks.en: Attention output. The injection source is the encoder output, and the target is the attention output of a transformer block. As shown in Figure 8 , this setting allows the noisy-input-dependent state to propagate to subsequent layers through the residual shortcut.
blocks.zh: 注意输出。 注射源为编码器输出,目标为变压器块的注意力输出. 如图8所示,此设置允许噪声输入依赖状态通过剩余快捷键向后续层传播.

blocks.en: Q/K/V. The injection source is the Q/K/V of the encoder’s last attention layer, and the target is the corresponding Q/K/V of a transformer block. We evaluate four variants: Q/K/V, K only, V only, and K/V, each replacing the corresponding component(s). In all four variants, the noisy-input-dependent state can still propagate to subsequent layers through the residual shortcut, as well as through whichever Q/K/V components remain unreplaced.
blocks.zh: 问/K/V. 注射源是编码器最后注意层的Q/K/V,目标为变压器块的相应Q/K/V. 我们评价四个变体:Q/K/V,只有K,只有V,以及K/V,每个变体取代相应的组件. 在所有四个变体中,噪声-输入依赖状态仍然可以通过剩余快捷方式传播到后续的层中,并且通过Q/K/V组件中的任何部分仍然未被替换.

blocks.en: We provide additional ablations of REPI when combined with REPA, examining the injection layer and internalization loss weight. blocks.en: Injection layer. Table 8 reports results obtained by varying the REPI injection layer while fixing the REPA alignment layer at layer 8. Placing the injection layer before the alignment layer yields better performance than placing it after, with injection at layer 4 achieving the best result. As discussed in Section 4.4 , placing REPI first allows the subsequent REPA objective to supervise a representation that has already incorporated the injected encoder structure, encouraging this structure to propagate through subsequent layers. By contrast, injecting after alignment modifies the subsequent computation and may weaken the influence of the earlier alignment supervision.
blocks.zh: 注射层. 表8 报告在将REPI注射层固定在层中的同时通过不同方式获得的结果 8. 将注射层置于对齐层之前,其性能优于其后,将注射层置于第4层,取得最佳效果。 如第4.4节所述,将REPI放在首位,使随后的REPA目标能够监督已经包含注入编码器结构的表示,鼓励这种结构通过后续层传播。 相比之下,对齐后注射会改变随后的计算,并可能削弱早期对齐监督的影响.

blocks.en: Internalization loss weight. Table 9 reports ablations on the internalization loss weight λ \lambda when combined with REPA.
